The pinned plan7.pyx checksum documentation (lines2682–2687) identifies it as calculated from the supplied alignment, rather than an inferred model parameter. This input-identity metadata does not supply the model emissions/transitions or domain-hit results. It is retained, rather than treating every already-derivable input property as an answer exposure.

solver_trace_review: Recorded tool commands inspect inputs and installed API/tests, build the profile from the supplied alignment using Builder.build_msa, search the supplied protein database using hmmsearch, and copy their own computed /tmp outputs into the output root. No recorded retrieval/copy of the removed precomputed HMM. Later local assertion errors do not overwrite these outputs. This is a bounded trajectory audit, not proof against covert behavior.
limitations: All workers share GLM-5.3. The independent solution uses the same PyHMMER/HMMER engine; no different-engine portability is established.
Installed asset discovery and the supplemental text audit are bounded and subject/name-scoped, not an exhaustive semantic or binary-filesystem proof.
